LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FIVE.titleTraditional: 地方 + 有／沒有 + 東西
LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FIVE.titleEnglish: Say What Is in a Place
LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FIVE.learnerPromise: Say what is in a place—and what is not there.
LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FIVE.explanation: Say the place first, then 有, then the thing that is there. Use 沒有—not 不有—to say something is not there.

teachingGlossary.meaning: there is not; there are not
none of them have; nowhere has
ending word for a yes/no question

teachingGlossary.pinyin: yì jiā hěn dà de cāntīng

discoveryLab.title: Change what the place contains
discoveryLab.description: Start with the place, then report whether something is there.

choices.label: Found
choices.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàngmiàn yǒu yì běn shū.
choices.english: There is a book on the table.
choices.note: Place first. 有 says the thing is there.

choices.label: Not found
choices.english: There is no book on the table.
choices.note: 沒有 is how you say “there is not”.

choices.label: Repair negative
choices.traditional: 桌子上面不有書 → 桌子上面沒有書
choices.simplified: 桌子上面不有书 → 桌子上面没有书
choices.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàngmiàn bù yǒu shū → Zhuōzi shàngmiàn méiyǒu shū
choices.english: There is no book on the table.
choices.note: Use 沒 with 有. Never use 不.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Place first. Use 有 when something is there; use 沒有 when it is not.

contrast.title: 在 says where. 有 says what is there.
contrast.description: Pick the form by what the listener already knows.

items.label: Find a known thing
items.english: The book is on the table.
items.note: Start with the known book and say where it is.

items.label: List what is in a place
items.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàngmiàn yǒu yì běn shū.
items.english: There is a book on the table.
items.note: Start with the place and say what is there.

patternRows.english: There is lots of delicious food in Taiwan.

grammar.meaning: there is not; there are not

patternRows.english: There is no café beside the library.
There are many things on the table.

items.question: There is a book on the table. 是 or 有?
items.answer: 有. It introduces what is in a place. 是 says what something is.

right.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàngmiàn yǒu yì běn shū.
right.english: There is a book on the table.

items.question: How do I say “there is no book”? Is it 不有?
items.answer: No. 有 takes 沒, never 不: 沒有.

right.english: There is no book on the table.

words.meaning: there is not; there are not

items.question: The book is already known. Do I say 桌子上面有書 or 書在桌子上面?
items.answer: 書在桌子上面 — start with the known thing and use 在. 有 introduces something new.

right.english: The book is on the table.

text.traditional: A：台灣有什麼好吃的東西？ B：水果、牛肉麵跟小籠包，我都很喜歡。
text.simplified: A：台湾有什么好吃的东西？ B：水果、牛肉面跟小笼包，我都很喜欢。
text.pinyin: A: Táiwān yǒu shénme hǎochī de dōngxi? B: Shuǐguǒ, niúròu miàn gēn xiǎolóngbāo, wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuān.
text.english: A: What delicious foods are in Taiwan? B: I like fruit, beef noodles, and soup dumplings.

text.traditional: A：你們學校旁邊有什麼？ B：我們學校旁邊有一家很大的餐廳。
text.simplified: A：你们学校旁边有什么？ B：我们学校旁边有一家很大的餐厅。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐmen xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu shénme? B: Wǒmen xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā hěn dà de cāntīng.
text.english: A: What is beside your school? B: There is a large restaurant beside our school.

words.pinyin: yì jiā hěn dà de cāntīng

text.traditional: A：那個房間裡面有桌子、椅子嗎？ B：房間裡面有一張桌子跟兩張椅子。
text.simplified: A：那个房间里面有桌子、椅子吗？ B：房间里面有一张桌子跟两张椅子。
text.pinyin: A: Nà ge fángjiān lǐmiàn yǒu zhuōzi, yǐzi ma? B: Fángjiān lǐmiàn yǒu yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn liǎng zhāng yǐzi.
text.english: A: Are there tables and chairs in that room? B: There is one table and two chairs.

words.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

tiles.traditional: 一千個學生有我們學校

segments.traditional: A：你家旁邊有飲料店嗎？ B：

segments.hint: Practice the correct “no” form of 有.

tiles.meaning: there is no drink shop beside my home

tiles.pinyin: wǒ jiā pángbiān bù yǒu yǐnliào diàn
tiles.meaning: incorrect negative

tiles.pinyin: yǐnliào diàn bú zài wǒ jiā pángbiān
tiles.meaning: the drink shop is not beside my home

questions.correctFeedback: 沒有 says there is none.
questions.repairFeedback: Make 有 negative with 沒: 沒有. Never say 不有.

segments.traditional: A：你的桌子上有什麼東西？ B：

segments.hint: Start with the place. Then name one thing.

tiles.pinyin: wǒ de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì běn shū
tiles.meaning: there is one book on my table

tiles.pinyin: yì běn shū zài wǒ de zhuōzi shàng
tiles.meaning: the book is on my table

tiles.pinyin: wǒ de zhuōzi shàng zài yì běn shū
tiles.meaning: uses 在 instead of 有

questions.correctFeedback: The question asks what is on the table. The place comes first, and 有 introduces the book.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 我的桌子上 + 有 + 一本書.

LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FOUR.learnerPromise: Locate something precisely: inside, on, under, beside, in front, or behind.
LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FOUR.explanation: A direction word needs an anchor word. Say the thing first, then add 上面, 下面, 裡面, 外面, 旁邊, 前面, or 後面. Together they make one place name.

teachingGlossary.meaning: there is not; there are not
none of them have; nowhere has
ending word for a yes/no question

teachingGlossary.pinyin: yì jiā hěn dà de cāntīng

discoveryLab.title: Change the direction word
discoveryLab.description: Keep the same anchor word. Change the direction word to move the thing.

choices.label: On
choices.english: The book is on the table.
choices.note: 桌子 is the anchor word; 上面 is the direction word.

choices.label: Under
choices.english: The book is under the table.
choices.note: Change the direction word, and the book moves under the table.

choices.label: Beside
choices.english: The book is beside the table.
choices.note: 旁邊 means next to the anchor word.

choices.label: Repair order
choices.traditional: 書在上面桌子 → 書在桌子上面
choices.simplified: 书在上面桌子 → 书在桌子上面
choices.pinyin: Shū zài shàngmiàn zhuōzi → Shū zài zhuōzi shàngmiàn
choices.english: The book is on the table.
choices.note: The anchor word must come before its direction word.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Thing + 在 + anchor + direction. Keep the anchor and its direction word together.

contrast.title: A place alone, or a place plus an action?
contrast.description: The same anchor + direction words can end a sentence or come before an action.

items.label: Location
items.english: The pen is under the chair.
items.note: The sentence ends after the place.

items.label: Action stage
items.note: The place comes before the action 睡覺.

patternRows.english: Your book is on the table.
The restaurant is not next to the school.

items.question: Can I just say 書在上面 to mean “on the table”?
items.answer: No. 上面 needs an anchor word. Name the thing first: 桌子上面.

right.english: The book is on the table.

items.question: Do I say 在下面椅子 or 在椅子下面?
items.answer: Anchor word first, direction second: 椅子下面.

right.english: The pen is under the chair.

items.question: My older brother is inside the room. Is it 在房間上面?
items.answer: No. 上面 means on top. For inside a room, use 裡面.

right.english: My older brother is inside the room.

text.traditional: A：那家餐廳在你家旁邊嗎？ B：不在我家旁邊，在我家後面。
text.simplified: A：那家餐厅在你家旁边吗？ B：不在我家旁边，在我家后面。
text.pinyin: A: Nà jiā cāntīng zài nǐ jiā pángbiān ma? B: Bú zài wǒ jiā pángbiān, zài wǒ jiā hòumiàn.
text.english: A: Is that restaurant next to your home? B: No, it is behind my home.

words.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

text.traditional: A：我的筆在哪裡？ B：你看，你的筆在椅子下面。
text.simplified: A：我的笔在哪里？ B：你看，你的笔在椅子下面。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ de bǐ zài nǎlǐ? B: Nǐ kàn, nǐ de bǐ zài yǐzi xiàmiàn.
text.english: A: Where is my pen? B: Look. Your pen is under the chair.

text.traditional: A：他們都在房間裡面嗎？ B：哥哥在房間裡面，我不知道弟弟在哪裡。
text.simplified: A：他们都在房间里面吗？ B：哥哥在房间里面，我不知道弟弟在哪里。
text.pinyin: A: Tāmen dōu zài fángjiān lǐmiàn ma? B: Gēge zài fángjiān lǐmiàn, wǒ bù zhīdào dìdi zài nǎlǐ.
text.english: A: Are they all inside the room? B: My older brother is inside the room. I do not know where my younger brother is.

words.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

text.pinyin: A: Táiwān yǒu shénme hǎochī de dōngxi? B: Shuǐguǒ, niúròu miàn gēn xiǎolóngbāo, wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuān.
text.english: A: What delicious foods are in Taiwan? B: I like fruit, beef noodles, and soup dumplings.

text.traditional: A：你們學校旁邊有什麼？ B：我們學校旁邊有一家很大的餐廳。
text.simplified: A：你们学校旁边有什么？ B：我们学校旁边有一家很大的餐厅。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐmen xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu shénme? B: Wǒmen xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā hěn dà de cāntīng.
text.english: A: What is beside your school? B: There is a large restaurant beside our school.

words.pinyin: yì jiā hěn dà de cāntīng

text.traditional: A：那個房間裡面有桌子、椅子嗎？ B：房間裡面有一張桌子跟兩張椅子。
text.simplified: A：那个房间里面有桌子、椅子吗？ B：房间里面有一张桌子跟两张椅子。
text.pinyin: A: Nà ge fángjiān lǐmiàn yǒu zhuōzi, yǐzi ma? B: Fángjiān lǐmiàn yǒu yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn liǎng zhāng yǐzi.
text.english: A: Are there tables and chairs in that room? B: There is one table and two chairs.

words.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Name the place first, then say what is there.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Answer each open book prompt with place + 有／沒有 + item.
grammarPages.exerciseNote: The book prints no answers. These sample answers use Lesson 5 words.

segments.traditional: A：我們學校有多少學生？ B：

segments.answer: 我們學校有一千個學生
segments.hint: Give a simple number after 有.

tiles.traditional: 我們學校有一千個學生
tiles.pinyin: wǒmen xuéxiào yǒu yìqiān ge xuésheng
tiles.meaning: our school has one thousand students

tiles.traditional: 一千個學生有我們學校
tiles.pinyin: yìqiān ge xuésheng yǒu wǒmen xuéxiào
tiles.meaning: reversed order

tiles.traditional: 我們學校在一千個學生
tiles.pinyin: wǒmen xuéxiào zài yìqiān ge xuésheng
tiles.meaning: uses 在 instead of 有

questions.correctFeedback: The school comes first. 有 introduces the number.

segments.traditional: A：你家旁邊有飲料店嗎？ B：

segments.hint: Practice the correct “no” form of 有.

tiles.pinyin: wǒ jiā pángbiān méiyǒu yǐnliào diàn
tiles.meaning: there is no drink shop beside my home

tiles.pinyin: wǒ jiā pángbiān bù yǒu yǐnliào diàn
tiles.meaning: incorrect negative

tiles.pinyin: yǐnliào diàn bú zài wǒ jiā pángbiān
tiles.meaning: the drink shop is not beside my home

questions.correctFeedback: 沒有 says there is none.
questions.repairFeedback: Make 有 negative with 沒: 沒有. Never say 不有.

segments.traditional: A：你的桌子上有什麼東西？ B：

segments.hint: Start with the place. Then name one thing.

tiles.pinyin: wǒ de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì běn shū
tiles.meaning: there is one book on my table

tiles.pinyin: yì běn shū zài wǒ de zhuōzi shàng
tiles.meaning: the book is on my table

tiles.pinyin: wǒ de zhuōzi shàng zài yì běn shū
tiles.meaning: uses 在 instead of 有

questions.correctFeedback: The question asks what is on the table. The place comes first, and 有 introduces the book.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 我的桌子上 + 有 + 一本書.

dialogue.title: 對話二 · Dialogue 2
dialogue.setting: 找不見的錢包 · Searching for a missing wallet

text.traditional: 媽，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的錢包不在房間裡。
text.simplified: 妈，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的钱包不在房间里。
text.pinyin: Mā, wǒ gēn Yǒuměi yào qù hē xiàwǔ chá, kěshì wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài fángjiān lǐ.
text.english: Mom, Youmei and I are going for afternoon tea, but my wallet is not in my room.

text.traditional: 客廳的桌子上有一個錢包，是不是你的？
text.simplified: 客厅的桌子上有一个钱包，是不是你的？
text.pinyin: Kètīng de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí ge qiánbāo, shì bú shì nǐ de?
text.english: There is a wallet on the living-room table. Is it yours?

text.traditional: 那不是我的，是哥哥的。我的錢包不在客廳裡。
text.simplified: 那不是我的，是哥哥的。我的钱包不在客厅里。
text.pinyin: Nà bú shì wǒ de, shì gēge de. Wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài kètīng lǐ.
text.english: That is not mine; it is my older brother’s. My wallet is not in the living room.

text.traditional: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
text.simplified: 沙发上面、下面跟旁边都没有。妈，妳帮我找，好吗？
text.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
text.english: It is not on, under, or beside the sofa. Mom, can you help me look?

words.meaning: none of them have; nowhere has

text.traditional: 我很忙，現在要去廚房做飯，你再去房間找吧。
text.simplified: 我很忙，现在要去厨房做饭，你再去房间找吧。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, xiànzài yào qù chúfáng zuòfàn, nǐ zài qù fángjiān zhǎo ba.
text.english: I am busy and need to cook. Go search your room again.

text.traditional: 啊！在這裡！錢包在我的書下面。
text.simplified: 啊！在这里！钱包在我的书下面。
text.pinyin: A! Zài zhèlǐ! Qiánbāo zài wǒ de shū xiàmiàn.
text.english: Ah, here it is! The wallet is under my book.
